title: Postern status response
description: Response body of GET /postern/v0/status. Answerable at conformance Level 1 and without credentials. See SPEC.md section 4.4.

id.description: Agent identifier (SPEC.md section 1.5). The same string describe reports and the distributor paths address.

state.description: not_required means no distributor is configured; the runner MUST NOT refuse to run on entitlement grounds. unknown means the runner cannot presently vouch: inside a declared grace period, or never having obtained an answer (SPEC.md section 5.7). checked_at tells those two apart.

checked_at.description: The distributor's own read time, propagated unchanged from the entitlement check. A runner MUST NOT re-stamp it with its own clock. REQUIRED when state is active or revoked.

stale_after_seconds.description: REQUIRED when state is active or revoked. With grace_seconds it bounds how long a revoked entitlement can keep working.

grace_seconds.description: The grace the distributor declared for an unreachable check (SPEC.md sections 5.3, 5.7), where the runner has been told one. A client needs it beside checked_at to say when an agent running through an outage stops.
